name: Restricted Projection Bridge Phase Declaration
purpose: Declare the QM-like / GR-like bridge phase as restricted comparison scaffolding only, preventing escalation into unification, derivation, or physical-law claims.

phase_definition.canonical_statement: The restricted projection bridge phase permits comparison between QM-like and GR-like projection domains only as governed projection analogs sharing possible source-relation traceability.
phase_definition.non_unification_rule: No bridge comparison may be interpreted as unification, derivation, or proof of physical equivalence.

bridge_governance_rules.rule: QM-like and GR-like domains remain projection-derived analog structures.
Bridge coherence cannot be interpreted as source identity.
All bridge artifacts require source_relation traceability and projection depth declarations.
Projection loss accounting is mandatory across bridge comparisons.
Bridge analysis remains ANALOG_ONLY and NON_PHYSICAL.
Any bridge artifact implying unification, derivation, or physical equivalence must fail validation.
